stem.text: The graph shows the variation with time of the acceleration of a car.

stem.alt: Graph of acceleration against time with a constant acceleration shown as a horizontal line, and the area between the line and the time axis shaded. Axes labelled acceleration and time, with the origin marked 0.

stem.text: What **must** the shaded area under the graph represent?

A.text: the average velocity of the car

B.text: the change in velocity of the car

C.text: the final velocity of the car

D.text: the initial velocity of the car
